title: Wanted
desc: A sharpshooter is caught between a gangster who wants him dead since he knows too much, the police who want him for the information he holds and his girlfriend who yearns for him to mend his ways.

title: Seetimaarr
desc: A strong-willed coach encounters a series of sinister impediments along his journey to turn a little-known women's kabaddi team into national champions.

title: Sabdham
desc: A paranormal investigator tackles mysterious university deaths. As evidence mounts, they question their beliefs and confront a possible supernatural threat.

title: Vijay The Master
